product.name: Monoprice DisplayPort 1.1 to HDTV Cable 6ft
product.description: This cable is designed to connect a DisplayPort® video source to an HDTV display that uses the standard HDMI® Type-A video connector. It complies with the DisplayPort 1.1 standard, which provides up to 10.8 Gbps. It can transmit 1080p@60Hz video with up to 48-bit Deep Color (16-bits per channel), as well as 4K@24Hz. The connectors are gold plated to ensure long term corrosion resistance and smooth connections. The DisplayPort connector features the standard mechanical latch to lock the cable connector to the panel connector.DisplayPort® and the DisplayPort® logo are registered trademarks of the Video Electronics Standards Association.
